think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any specific numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) are documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (such as disabling a feature, using an automatic/default behavior distinct from the normal numeric ordering). 3) If such a value exists and changes behavior in a non-monotonic or mode-switching way, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s). Otherwise, classify as not special.
